title: Lorentzian coarea inequality
summary: In this article, we introduce the notion of locally uniformly d-controlling map between Lorentzian pre-length spaces which is preserving the diameters of causal diamonds, and through that we establish the coarea inequality for Lorentzian Hausdorff measure which is introduced by McCann and Sämann. Besides that we get a covering lemma for subsets in a Lorentzian pre-length space with a new local assumption named the local causal enlargement property, which enables us to enlarge causal diamonds.
